methodology: Desktop full audit (technical UX areas) from fresh crawl in data/ux-manifest.json (67 URLs), programmatic playwright checks, and evidence under evidence/ux/desktop/. Calibration-first against scripts/ux_rubric.py tier anchors.

calibration.rationale: Major friction on content access; workaround = browse /guides index. QA rated HIGH.
Rubric calibration verbatim: 'search returning 0 results for normal queries'.
NOT a bug - scroll-triggered count-up verified working; not filed (QA desktop-20260801-181039-55).
Rubric calibration verbatim: '"0 verified clinics" vs "17,020+" claim'.

findings.title: Header and footer navigation links return HTTP 404
findings.description: Nine /guides/ and three /services/ links in the header and footer resolve to HTTP 404.
findings.notes: Calibration: 12 broken nav links -> navigation area, tier Most Important (major friction, workaround = browse /guides index). Consolidated from 12 QA 404s; affected_pages below.

findings.title: Site-wide search returns 0 results for a normal brand query
findings.description: Searching 'Botox' on the directory search returns 0 results across providers and clinics.
findings.notes: Calibration: search 0 results -> journey_friction, tier Critical (rubric calibration example verbatim). Core 'find an injector' journey blocked.

findings.title: Homepage clinic claims contradict empty clinics directory
findings.description: Homepage advertises 17,020+ clinics and 12,400+ injectors while the clinics directory renders 'No verified clinics or injectors match.'
findings.notes: Calibration: stats-vs-clinics mismatch -> Critical tier (rubric calibration example verbatim). Misleading claim with potential real-world harm; no solutions in description.

findings.title: News listing logs 23 console errors on load
findings.description: The /news listing logs 23 console errors on load, the most of any page.
findings.notes: UX manifest desktop: /news console_errors=23 (highest). QA finding desktop-20260801-181649-59 covers the same defect.

findings.title: Console errors logged on every crawled page
findings.description: All 67 desktop pages log console errors including WOFF2 font parsing and WebGL warnings.
findings.notes: UX manifest desktop: every one of 67 pages has console_errors >= 4. Live sample errors: 'OTS parsing error: Size of decompressed WOFF 2.0 is less than compressed size', 'WebGL: INVALID_ENUM', 'No available adapters.', 404 resource loads.

findings.title: News listing renders 21 broken article thumbnails
findings.description: The /news listing shows 21 broken article images via the Next.js image optimizer.
findings.notes: UX manifest desktop: /news broken_images=21; 10 article pages each 1 broken image. QA finding covers listing + articles.

findings.title: Broken CDN images across brand, service and state pages
findings.description: Brand, service and state pages render broken media.alle.com CDN images, up to 20 per page.
findings.notes: UX manifest desktop: broken CDN images on 32 pages. Worst: services/back-includes-bra-fat 20, services/abdomen 18, brands/kybella 16, services/cheek-filler 16, services/chin-filler 17, services/buttock 15, new-york 14, florida 13.

findings.title: State and city pages load in 5 to 15 seconds
findings.description: State and city pages take 5.1 to 14.8 seconds to load, /california the slowest.
findings.notes: UX manifest desktop load_time_ms: /california 14769, /new-york/new-york-ny 9259, /illinois/chicago-il 7775, /florida 6791, /services/buttock 5113. Avg across 67 pages 1815ms; these 5 exceed 5s. No QA ref (QA load findings used different crawl timing).

findings.title: Form inputs lack accessible labels or aria-labels
findings.description: Newsletter 'First name', footer 'website' and directory search inputs have no accessible label or aria-label.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright) on desktop: placeholder-only inputs with no label/aria on homepage, /clinics, /search, guides, /contact, /login, /california. Same defect as QA mobile-t12-1785644915-1 (4 instances, 3 pages) confirmed on desktop too. html[lang]=en and single h1 verified correct.

findings.title: BRANDS accordion pre-expanded on page load across the site
findings.description: The BRANDS accordion button in the header menu loads with aria-expanded=true on every page while the SERVICES and LEARN accordions load collapsed.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright, 1920x1080) across /, /news, /guides, /california, /brands/botox: #nav-brands-btn aria-expanded=true on initial load (panel height 137px) while #nav-services-btn and #nav-learn-btn are false. The header accordion card is opacity-0 until the burger menu opens, so BRANDS content is pre-expanded but invisible; when the drawer opens, BRANDS is already open while its siblings are closed. Distinct from mobile menu tap-target defect (mobile report).

findings.title: Escape key does not close open header accordion panels
findings.description: Pressing Escape while a header accordion panel is open leaves the panel expanded with aria-expanded=true unchanged.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright): click #nav-services-btn (aria-expanded true), send Escape, re-read -> aria-expanded still true and panel remains visible at same height. Keyboard users cannot dismiss an open dropdown with Escape.

findings.title: Contact and List Your Practice pages provide no contact form
findings.description: The /contact and /list-your-practice pages contain no contact or submission form, only a newsletter signup form with website, first name and email fields.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright): /contact h1='Contact' but the only form is the newsletter form (inputs: website, First name optional, you@email.com, submit 'Subscribe'); 5 mailto links present, no textarea or message form. /list-your-practice h1='List your practice on injector.world' but the only form is the same newsletter form (plus hidden cf-turnstile-response); 1 mailto link. Primary user goal of each page (contact / submit practice) has no form.

findings.title: 12px slate-400 text fails WCAG AA contrast on state and brand pages
findings.description: State and brand pages render 12px rgb(148,163,184) text such as 'Showing 24 of 2,510 results' at a 2.56:1 contrast ratio against white.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright) with computed contrast: rgb(148,163,184) on white = 2.56:1, on warm bg = 2.40:1; WCAG AA normal text requires 4.5:1. Occurrences: /california and /new-york 'Showing 24 of X results', /brands/botox 'AVG. COST', 'per session', 'STEP 1: PICK A STATE', 'POPULAR:'. QA mobile-t12-1785644915-5 confirmed no key text-over-image contrast issue, but this is a separate body-text contrast defect.

findings.title: Homepage Featured Clinics section renders placeholder test clinics
findings.description: The homepage Featured Clinics section displays cards named 'Test Clinic', 'ABCD Clinic' and 'Rishav's Clinic' with prices and links.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright): Featured Clinics section on / shows test/placeholder clinic cards ('Test Clinic', 'ABCD Clinic', 'Rishav's Clinic', all Houston, TX, 'from $15'/'from $25') with working links to /clinics/texas/houston-tx/testclinic etc. (all return 200, h1='Test Clinic'), mixed with real clinics (Sinful Skin Injections, SUMMIT AESTHETICS, AgeLess Medical Aesthetics) that have no price line. Visible on the homepage to all visitors.

findings.title: Footer renders 41 links with no heading structure
findings.description: The site-wide footer contains 41 links and 2 buttons with no heading elements to group or label the navigation sections.
findings.notes: Programmatic check (playwright): footer on / contains 41 links and 2 buttons but zero h1-h6 headings, so screen-reader users get an unlabeled flat list of links. Minor structural accessibility defect, distinct from the 12 broken footer links already filed as UX-D-001.

observations.note: No horizontal overflow at 1366/1024/768 on 6 sampled static pages (playwright check scrollWidth==clientWidth). Responsive screenshots captured for all 67 pages in evidence/ux/desktop/.
Sticky header verified (position sticky, top 0, stays at top after scroll on /, /clinics, /guides). 'Back to top' button present and scrolls to top on click.
html[lang]=en present and exactly one h1 per page across 10 sampled pages. Footer brand mark image (footer-mark.png) has empty alt - single minor instance, below finding threshold.
All 12 broken links found on desktop are the header/footer navigation 404s filed under navigation (UX-D-001) per calibration. No other broken internal or external links observed in the crawl.
Desktop device; mobile responsiveness is evaluated in the mobile report (T5/T7). Recorded as checked for desktop coverage completeness.

Checked: hover states verified on homepage (Find Your Injector hero CTA bg rgba(0,0,0,0)->rgba(0,0,0,0.03) on hover; cursor pointer on all visible buttons; Ask AI button correctly disabled when input empty). No defect found on desktop.
Checked: Featured Clinics card grid on / aligned to 3 even columns (lefts 681/1087/1494, rows 3140/3433, card width uniform); 'View' link styling consistent across cards. No misalignment found.

In addition to UX-D-010/011: SERVICES and LEARN accordions correctly collapsed on load; burger menu opens the header drawer (opacity-0 card becomes opacity-1); nav links inside accordions navigate correctly.

Body text contrast verified: slate-600 #475569 on white = 7.58:1 PASS, white on navy = 17.2:1 PASS, 70% white on dark navy = 9.27:1 PASS. Heading hierarchy present (h1 unique per page, Fraunces display / Inter body). Only the 12px slate-400 text filed as UX-D-013.

Header on desktop 1920px shows logo, hamburger ('Open menu'), search, sign in, list your practice, dark-mode toggle; no inline nav links visible at 1920px width - all BRANDS/SERVICES/LEARN links are behind the hamburger drawer. Footer 41 links, 2 buttons, no headings (UX-D-015).

Newsletter form on /, /contact, /list-your-practice: invalid email correctly blocked by HTML5 validation (checkValidity false, validationMessage present, focus stays). Search form on /search works. /contact and /list-your-practice lack a contact form (UX-D-012).
Heading sizes consistent across page types (56px page h1; 52px section h2; 24px card h2; 16px card h3). Homepage Featured Clinics placeholder data filed as UX-D-014.
